justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/Strings.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringsTest.java. CiStrings is a private static final nested strategy class with one constructor and 6 overridden methods (compare, contains, two equals overloads, indexOf, lastIndexOf), all narrowly focused on case-insensitive comparison/search behavior. The test class exercises only those cohesive behaviors; there is no evidence of many unrelated responsibilities, large size, or a need to split the class further.
